Overview

Kayseri is a city in Kayseri with a population of 1,389,000. A rapidly growing industrial city at the foot of Mount Erciyes, known for its skiing and manufacturing. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
